tools.name: search_cards
tools.description:
Use this when the user names a trading card or sealed product and you need its
    TickerMint product_id (required by card_price and price_history) or its set id
    (group_id, required by set_prices). Returns up to 25 matches with name, set,
    collector number, the latest raw market price in USD

tools.name: card_price
tools.description:
Use this when the user asks what one specific card or sealed product is worth
    today. Returns the latest daily TCGplayer market price and lowest listed price per
    printing (Normal, Holofoil, Reverse Holofoil, 1st Edition...) with the date of the
    price, in USD, plus `headline` (the printing

tools.name: graded_price
tools.description:
Use this when the user asks what a graded (slabbed) copy of one card is worth, or
    how much more a PSA 10 sells for than a raw copy. Returns PriceCharting's values from
    sold listings for each grade it has (PSA 10, BGS 10, CGC 10, SGC 10, TAG 10 and
    grades 7, 8, 9 and 9.5 from any grader),

tools.name: price_history
tools.description:
Use this when the user asks whether a card's price is going up or down, how it
    moved over a period, or what it was worth on a past date. Returns the market price
    per printing in USD for the last `days` days (7 to 1000; history starts February
    2024, later for newer cards): daily for the m

tools.name: most_valuable
tools.description:
Use this when the user asks for the most expensive or most valuable cards in
    one game right now. Returns up to 25 singles ranked by today's raw market price
    (USD) with set and printing. Raw prices only, not graded values.

tools.name: market_index
tools.description:
Use this when the user asks how one game's card market as a whole is doing, or
    for the TickerMint index (for example the TickerMint Pokemon 100). Returns the index
    level with its date, its 1-day, 7-day, 30-day and year-to-date change in percent, its
    all-time high, the largest constituent

tools.name: movers
tools.description:
Use this when the user asks which cards in one game rose or fell the most
    recently. Returns the biggest percentage moves over the last `days` (1 to 90) for
    cards worth $5 or more, with the start and end market price in USD. Describes past
    moves only; not a prediction.

tools.name: all_time_highs
tools.description:
Use this when the user asks which cards in one game are at a record price.
    Returns cards that set their highest market price since TickerMint began tracking
    the game (February 2024 for Pokemon, One Piece and Lorcana; later for the others,
    see `tracked_since`) in the last 7 days and still

tools.name: all_time_lows
tools.description:
Use this when the user asks which cards in one game are at their lowest price
    or have crashed. Returns cards worth $5+ sitting at their lowest market price since
    TickerMint began tracking (all-time for cards released after that day, see each
    card's `low_scope`) after falling at least 50%

tools.name: sealed_prices
tools.description:
Use this when the user asks about sealed product prices in one game: booster
    boxes, elite trainer boxes, bundles, packs, tins and cases. Returns today's market
    price (USD) and 30-day percent change per product, most expensive first. For one
    named product, search_cards plus card_price is

tools.name: set_prices
tools.description:
Use this when the user asks what a set is worth, what it costs to complete, or
    which cards in one set are the most valuable. Returns the cost to complete the set
    in singles today (one copy of each collector number at its cheapest printing, USD,
    the same figure as the set page), the maste

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Use this to look up trading cards or sealed products (Pokemon, One Piece, Disney Lorcana, Riftbound, Yu-Gi-Oh, Gundam and Dragon Ball Super Fusion World) by name.
    Returns up to 10 matches with ids to pass to `fetch`.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description:
Use this after `search` to read one product: today's market price per printing
    (USD), its move over the last 90 days and the page URL.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_cards" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
